description:
Exide Magic 1125VA 12V home inverter is a high-value power backup inverter for Indian homes facing frequent power cuts and low voltage. With a 1125VA capacity, it keeps essentials running—ceiling fans, LED lights, Wi‑Fi router, set‑top box and TV—so your rooms stay livable during humid summer outages. The wide 100V–290V input range helps it charge and perform steadily even when mains voltage swings.

Powered by ASIC (Auto Sense Intelligent Control) charging, it senses battery condition and adjusts charging for healthier backup performance. You get a regulated 235V ± 15V output at 50Hz ± 1Hz with up to 95% efficiency, plus protective circuits for overload, short circuit, AC back feed, low battery, battery overcharge, mains overload and overheating. Built in a sturdy metal-plastic chassis with soft-touch controls and backed by a 42-month warranty, it’s a dependable single-battery home UPS solution when installed indoors in a dry, well-ventilated spot.
